verses.1: And this is what you must do: To make them holy for me as priests. You must take one apple in the morning, and two fresh ears of grain.
verses.2: And loaves of bread and unleavened bread are made in the oven. The edges of the loaves are also cooked in the oven. Hemp fibers are used to make these loaves.
verses.3: And you placed them on one shelf, and then you sacrificed them along with the grain and the two oxen.
verses.4: And Aaron and his sons were brought before the entrance of the priest’s tent, and they were washed in the water.
verses.5: And you took the garments, and you covered Aaron with them. You also put on his robe, along with all the other accessories. Then you anointed him with the oil as part of the ritual.
verses.6: And you placed the crown on his head, and you laid the sacred prize upon the crown.
verses.7: And you will take the wine that is to be poured, and you will pour it on his head. Then you will drink it.
verses.8: And he will bring his children forward, and they will be burned as offerings.
verses.9: And you confined them in the prison of Aaron and his sons. You sealed them with seals, so that they would become a law for all time. Thus, the hands of Aaron and his sons were sealed as a sign of their status.
verses.10: And you brought the offering before the altar of the Lord. And Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the offering.
verses.11: And you slaughtered the grain before Jehovah’s altar.
verses.12: And you shall take some of the blood from the apple, and apply it to the horns of the altar with your finger. Then, all of that blood should be poured into the trench around the altar.
verses.13: And you took all the milk that covered the bread, as well as the extra milk on top of it. You also took both of the containers in which the milk was stored. Then you drained out all the milk from those containers.
verses.14: And the grain, and the vineyard, and all its produce will be burned by fire from outside the camp of sinners.
verses.15: And take that one lamb. Aaron and his sons shall hold their hands over the head of the lamb.
verses.16: And you slaughtered the lamb, took its blood, and sprinkled it on the altar around it.
verses.17: And the meat was laid out for his burial. You washed his ribs and his legs, and then you placed them on his chest and on his head.
verses.18: And you have made all the sacrificed animals go up to heaven. It smells wonderful to God. It’s a pleasant aroma for God.
verses.19: And you took the second lamb, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the lamb.
verses.20: And you slaughtered the sheep, took some of its blood, and applied it to Aaron’s forehead. You also applied it to the foreheads of his sons, as well as to their right hands and right feet. Then you poured the blood around the altar.
verses.21: And you took from the blood that was on the altar, and from the smoke of the burning incense. You sanctified it by placing it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons.
verses.22: And you took from the river the milk and the aliyah. You also took the milk that covered the ground, along with all the remaining freshness. You also took the two kidneys, along with the milk that covered them. And you took the right kidney, for it was one of the two kidneys.
verses.23: And one loaf of bread, and one jar of honey, and one handful from the basket of offerings that is before Jehovah.
verses.24: And you placed all of this upon Aaron’s shoulders, and upon his sons’ shoulders. Then you brought them before the LORD.
verses.25: And you took them from their hands, and you prepared the sacrifice on the altar, so that it might smell sweet before Jehovah. This woman was a sacrifice to Jehovah.
verses.26: And you took the Urim from the staff of Aaron. You threw it before Jehovah, and it became your standard.
verses.27: And you shall sanctify the altar of burnt offering, as well as the altar of grain offering. This is the altar that was built for Aaron and his sons.
verses.28: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons to be a statute forever among the children of Israel. For they will offer sacrifices to Jehovah from the offerings of the Israelites.
verses.29: And on the sides of the sacred vessels, which belong to Aaron, they shall place their children’s bodies after them, so that they can be buried in them and so that their blood may be poured out there.
verses.30: For seven days, the priest shall cover himself with the clothes that he wears when he goes to the altar to serve on the Sabbath.
verses.31: And take the ram that is offered as an offering. And in the holy place, cut off its throat.
verses.32: And Aaron and his sons ate the meat of the sacrificed animal, as well as the bread that was placed in the entrance of the altar.
verses.33: And they ate them, since they were considered sacred by those who wanted to sanctify their hands through eating them. But a stranger was not allowed to eat them, because they were sacred.
verses.34: And if it is found to be holy, from the meat of the sacrifices and from the pot, from evening until morning, and if it is burned with fire, then it cannot be eaten, because it is holy.
verses.35: And you made Aaron and his sons do as I commanded you to do. They were to cover their hands with blood for seven days.
verses.36: And you shall do what is wrong on that day for the priests. You shall sin against the altar, and you shall defile it by your actions. You will make it unclean for its use.
verses.37: For seventeen days, the altar shall be sanctified. It shall be kept holy. And the altar itself will become holy. Everyone who touches the altar will also be sanctified.
verses.38: And this is what you must do with the altar: You must burn the children of the year for two days, always.
verses.39: The first task will be done in the morning, and the second task will be done between noon and evening.
verses.40: And ten sicles of balul were poured into the vessel. Half of that amount was then poured into the other vessel.
verses.41: And the second offering shall be made between the evenings, as an offering for the morning. And its aroma shall be like that of a fragrant incense to the LORD.
verses.42: May the doors always be open for your meetings. There shall be a meeting place before Jehovah’s face, where He will speak to you there.
verses.43: And I will be honored among the children of Israel, and I will be sanctified in my own place.
verses.44: And I will sanctify the Tabernacle, and also the altar, and Aaron and his sons. They shall be set aside as priests for me.
verses.45: And I slept among the children of Israel, and I became their god.
verses.46: And they shall know that I, the LORD their God, am who has brought them out of the land of Egypt to be their God. I, the LORD, am their God.
